verdict.rationale: Kit ships 'Unlimited Visual Automations' as a core product feature and exposes a remote Kit MCP server that lets AI clients read/write a creator's account (subscribers, sequences, broadcasts, tags, segments) via natural-language prompts, which implies AI-driven setup of automated flows. However, there's no explicit documentation showing the MCP or API can create/trigger Visual Automations themselves (only broadcasts/subscribers/tags are called out), nor evidence of autonomous background execution triggered by AI without a user request. Missing for 10: explicit MCP/API coverage of the Visual Automations builder itself, and evidence of unattended/scheduled autonomous runs initiated by an agent.
